entities.name: N-acetyl amide reduction
observations: SELFIES decode: reactant CCN(CC(C)NC1=C(C)C=CC=C1C)C(C)=O; product CCN(CC)CC(C)NC1=C(C)C=CC=C1C.
Transformation replaces N-C(=O)CH3 with N-CH2CH3, consistent with reductive deoxygenation of a tertiary amide to a tertiary amine.
An exact or near-exact ORD record supports lithium aluminium hydride in diethyl ether for this transformation.

entities.name: Lithium aluminium hydride
observations: LiAlH4 is supported as the reducing reagent for conversion of the N-acetyl tertiary amide to the corresponding N-ethyl tertiary amine.

entities.name: LAH in diethyl ether
observations: The matched reaction record uses lithium aluminium hydride with diethyl ether as solvent.
